# trefolio — Full Product Information

> The simplest way to track your stock portfolio with AI-powered insights. Built for European investors.

## What is trefolio?

trefolio is a web-based portfolio tracking application designed for European retail investors. It provides a clean, modern dashboard to track stock and ETF holdings across multiple exchanges, with real-time quotes, dividend tracking, performance metrics, and AI-powered analysis.

## Target Audience

- Primary: Beginner-to-intermediate retail investors in Europe (roughly 5–50 stocks/ETFs)
- Secondary: Expats with multi-currency portfolios
- Tertiary: Non-English-speaking European investors (35 languages supported)

## Core Features

### Portfolio Dashboard
- Real-time stock quotes from Yahoo Finance
- Multi-exchange support: NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, Amsterdam (AMS), Madrid (MAD), Copenhagen (OMK), and more
- Multi-currency: automatic conversion between EUR, USD, GBP, DKK, and CAD
- Daily changes, total value, per-stock breakdowns
- Benchmark comparison with S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Jones, and Euro Stoxx 50
- Portfolio growth projections with customizable parameters

### Performance Metrics
- TTWROR (Time-Weighted Rate of Return) using the Modified Dietz method
- IRR (Internal Rate of Return) using the XIRR method
- Clear methodology explanations in the UI

### Dividend Tracking
- Estimated annual dividend income
- Per-stock yield breakdowns
- 5-year growth projections
- Historical dividend calendar

### Broker Import
All 7 import methods on one unified /import page:
- DEGIRO Account CSV (includes cash balance detection)
- Interactive Brokers Activity Statement and Flex Query CSV
- Interactive Brokers API (direct sync via guided 3-step wizard, Trefolio plan)
- Trading 212 History CSV export
- Revolut Account Statement (Excel/CSV)
- Simple CSV format (ticker, type, price, amount, currency)
- AI-powered smart import from screenshots, PDFs, and unstructured data

### AI Analysis (Pro)
- AI Portfolio Review with personalized recommendations (5 reviews/month)
- Plain-language stock fundamentals analysis
- News sentiment analysis (bullish/bearish)
- Insider and institutional activity insights
- Economic indicators analysis
- Powered by OpenAI GPT

### Additional Features
- Price alerts (2 for Free, unlimited + email for Pro)
- CSV export of holdings, transactions, and cash balances (Pro)
- Dark and light mode, plus 4 dashboard themes (Default, Canvas, Terminal, Studio)
- 35 European languages
- Cash balance tracking
- Privacy-first: no tracking cookies, no data selling
- PWA support (installable on mobile and desktop)

## Pricing Details

### Free Plan (€0 forever)
- Up to 15 stocks & ETFs
- Real-time Yahoo Finance quotes
- Historical price charts
- Cash balance tracking
- Benchmark comparison (S&P 500, etc.)
- DEGIRO, IBKR, Trading 212 & Revolut import
- Portfolio growth projection
- Dark & light mode
- English + Spanish
- 5 AI analysis calls/month
- 2 price alerts (in-app)

### Bifolio Plan (€2.99/month or €23.99/year)
Everything in Free, plus:
- Up to 50 holdings
- 20 AI analysis calls/month
- 10 price alerts + email & push notifications
- Full portfolio growth history (all time)
- Advanced metrics (Sharpe Ratio, Max Drawdown, Volatility)
- Portfolio sharing (public link)
- CSV export of holdings & transactions

### Trefolio Plan (€7.99/month or €59.99/year)
Everything in Bifolio, plus:
- Unlimited holdings
- Unlimited AI analysis
- Company fundamentals (income, balance, cash flow)
- Stock intelligence (news sentiment, insider trades)
- Institutional holdings data
- Economic indicators dashboard
- Alpha Vantage premium data
- AI Portfolio Review (5/month)
- Unlimited price alerts + email delivery
- IBKR API direct sync
- Priority support

## Supported Exchanges

NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, Amsterdam (AMS), Madrid (MAD), Copenhagen (OMK), and additional exchanges via Yahoo Finance.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Database: Turso (libSQL)
- Hosting: Vercel
- AI: OpenAI GPT
- Payments: Stripe
- Market Data: Yahoo Finance, Alpha Vantage (Pro)
- Mobile: Progressive Web App (PWA) + Capacitor (iOS, Android)

## Data & Privacy

- GDPR-compliant, built in Europe
- Passwords hashed with bcrypt
- Sessions use secure HTTP-only cookies
- All data encrypted at rest
- No advertising, tracking, or third-party cookies
- Data never sold or shared with third parties
- Users can delete their account and data at any time

## Third-Party Services

- Yahoo Finance: real-time market data
- Alpha Vantage: premium market data (Pro)
- OpenAI: AI-powered analysis
- Stripe: payment processing
- Vercel: hosting and deployment
- Turso (libSQL): database

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I import my portfolio?
Go to the unified /import page to access all 7 import methods in one place: DEGIRO, IBKR CSV, IBKR API, Trading 212, Revolut, Simple CSV, and AI Import. Each method has a built-in step-by-step guide. For CSV or AI import: choose your method, drag & drop your file (or paste for AI), review the parsed transactions, and click Import. Trefolio users can connect via IBKR API with a guided 3-step wizard that takes under 2 minutes.

### What CSV formats are supported?
Six CSV formats plus AI Import: (1) DEGIRO Account.csv, (2) IBKR CSV (Activity Statement or Flex Query), (3) Trading 212 History CSV, (4) Revolut Account Statement (Excel/CSV), (5) Simple CSV with columns: ticker, type, price, amount, currency. For any other format, use AI Import — upload or paste your file and AI will parse it. Trefolio users get IBKR API for direct sync — connect once, re-sync anytime with one click.

### Is my data secure?
Yes. All data is encrypted at rest, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and sessions use secure HTTP-only cookies. We never sell or share your data with third parties.

### What exchanges are supported?
trefolio supports NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, Amsterdam (AMS), Madrid (MAD), Copenhagen (OMK), and more. Multi-currency conversion between EUR, USD, GBP, DKK, and CAD is handled automatically.

### How are performance metrics calculated?
TTWROR uses the Modified Dietz method, which weights each cash flow by the fraction of the period remaining — so returns reflect market performance only, not deposit timing. IRR (XIRR) finds the annualized rate that makes the net present value of all dated cash flows equal zero.

### What's the difference between the plans?
Folio (free) includes up to 15 holdings, real-time quotes, charts, growth projection, broker import, and 5 AI calls/month. Bifolio (€2.99/month) adds 50 holdings, 20 AI calls, full portfolio history, advanced metrics (Sharpe, Drawdown, Volatility), portfolio sharing, and CSV export. Trefolio (€7.99/month) adds unlimited holdings, unlimited AI analysis, company fundamentals, stock intelligence, economic indicators, and Alpha Vantage premium data.

### Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Bifolio and Trefolio are billed monthly or annually (save ~37%). You can cancel anytime from the billing portal — your paid features remain active until the end of the billing period.

### How do dividends and fees get tracked?
When you import a broker CSV (DEGIRO, IBKR, Trading 212, or Revolut), dividends, withholding taxes, and broker fees are parsed automatically. For Simple CSV imports, use the type column with 'dividend' or 'fee' values. All transactions are stored in your ledger and reflected in performance metrics.
